Results.ReviewText: I never was much for cookouts until I started using the Weber Genesis grill owned by my condo association in Florida. I liked cooking on it so much that I decided to buy a new grill for my permanent residence in Michigan. I wanted a Weber because of the reputation and high customer satisfaction including my own. I must say I was rather shocked at how much pricier the Weber grills are compared to other grills. I could have bought a much larger grill in just about any other grill with many more bells and whistles for less money than this little grill. Since I'm a single person, I thought this would be plenty big enough for me. Well, for the most part it is big enough for just me, but if I have two or three guests, I quickly run out of grilling space to grill steaks and veggies at the same time. So I'd say its a great grill, but unsure if it was worth sacrificing the grilling space just so I could get a Weber.
Results.Title: Great Grill, Just Wish it Was a Little Bigger

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
